headline: Sound adversarial cooldown denial: the entry-tier card had an increase 60 days ago against a 120-day cooldown, with only a minor wording conflict between two CLI documents.

issues.summary: logistics_005 says to confirm eligibility before submitting, and logistics_007 says to submit first. Gold requires both the PENDING submit record and the DENIED record.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005: "Before submitting a CLI request, confirm all of the following for your card tier"
doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007: "Eligibility checks are internal and not exposed to customers, so the submission must happen first."
gold[2] submit requested_increase_amount 400; gold[12] deny cooldown_period_active
issues.why_it_matters: The internal doc is explicit, so this is resolvable. An agent that checks the cooldown first and refuses to submit would miss both gold writes.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a pointer in logistics_005 to the internal workflow in logistics_007.

solution_check: Bronze is entry-tier (general_015), and 10% of $4,000 = $400 is under the 25% maximum. Submit 400. The CLI history shows an approval submitted 2025-09-15, 60 days before 11/14/2025 and under the 120-day entry-tier cooldown (logistics_005), so deny with cooldown_period_active. Other criteria pass: utilization 37.5%, 8 on-time payments, account opened 05/10/2023. This matches gold, and the gold replay runs without errors.
prior_note: The prior review rated this clean. Required doc logistics_005 changed only by removing '$' corruption; the cross-doc ordering conflict was not reported before.
notes: Grading-model facts confirmed against snapshot: EnvironmentEvaluator replays gold on a fresh env and requires equal agent+user DB hashes (in this domain both toolkits share one TransactionalDB, so the two hashes are identical); _derive_read_log_allowlist logs discoverable READ calls only when gold calls them, but discoverable WRITE calls are logged by tool name even when the tool returns an error string; numbers in call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool are parsed with parse_int=float; get_now() = 2025-11-14 03:40:00. unlock_discoverable_agent_tool is in-memory only and never hashed. The initial_state payment_history rows use ISO dates ('2025-10-15') while the seed rows use MM/DD/YYYY, so get_payment_history_6183's string sort mixes formats. All rows are ON_TIME, so the decision is unaffected.
